summary: Reproduced the PD prefill inflight success race at the scheduler queue boundary: a pending FINISH_ABORT in req.to_finish was overwritten by FINISH_LENGTH. The success path now promotes a pending abort through Req.update_finish_state() before applying the normal length completion. Regression coverage preserves the abort message/status and checks already-promoted-abort and ordinary-success boundaries.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before queue-level reproduction: pending FINISH_ABORT(status_code=503) became FINISH_LENGTH on KVPoll.Success; the ordinary-success boundary passed. Raw output: reports/j-4ccc0b62f011/raw/failing-before.log

Passing-after related unit suite: 14 tests passed, including pending abort preservation, already-promoted abort preservation, normal successful transfer length completion, and existing abort cleanup boundaries. Raw output: reports/j-4ccc0b62f011/raw/passing-after.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect is a deterministic scheduler state transition before response streaming and requires no tensor execution. No GPU or full-model claim is made.

remaining_limitations: No Qwen2-7B weights were available, so the original two-node PD HTTP reproduction was not run.

The test directly exercises the actual process_disagg_prefill_inflight_queue implementation with a mocked successful transfer poll; it does not qualify multi-node transport behavior, model semantics, or NVIDIA H100 hardware.
HTTP status propagation beyond the preserved FINISH_ABORT object was not exercised end-to-end; the regression verifies its status_code=503 and abort type at the scheduler output boundary.
